messages:
ana (PM): Quick sync — we need final signoff on GA criteria for the SmartRouting initiative. Sharing risk heatmap and minimal acceptance list. Main gaps: SLA SLO thresholds, customer-facing pricing knobs, docs runbook, monitoring alerts tuning, support playbook. Please ack + flag hard blockers by EOD.

Dave (Eng): looked at heatmap; main eng risk is cold-start tail under burst. Working on batching config + fallback routing. Need clarified SLA to wire tests.

sre-bot: Incident-sim job queued: load-test/smartrouting-20231115 -> report will land in /shared/reports/smartrouting-loadtest-2311002222.json

maria (Docs): I can draft GA docs + runbook but need exact error codes and expected user flows. Also decision on which examples to ship (short vs. long prompt).

linda (Support): Support playbook draft ready for internal review. Still waiting on canary -> prod error mapping from eng.

kevin-sales: Pricing question — PMs, we need a simple per-request pricing knob + reserved tiers for GA pricing page. Can we get ballpark numbers by Thurs?

Dave (Eng): SLA proposal (working idea): p95 latency <200ms for standard API tier (99.9% monthly), dedicated tier p95 targets tighter (99.99%). Define billing credit/backstop for sustained breaches. I'll push a test harness PR.

ana (PM): Draft SLA snippet (source of truth for docs & tests):
```
SLA:
  - Monthly uptime: 99.9% (Hosted API - Standard)
  - Latency SLOs: p50/p95/p99 targets per model. Initial p95 target = 200ms for standard workloads.
  - Remediation: billing credit % TBD for sustained breach (>72h).
```
Need legal + finance to approve remediation calc and copy.

kevin-sales: looping in @tara-legal and @omar-finance for remediation language + reserved tiers.

maria (Docs): For runbook I need: sample curl, error table, escalation matrix, and SLA blurb to copy-paste. Will template examples after SLA finalized.

linda (Support): Proposed triage flow: identify degraded model -> check canary metrics -> trigger fallback -> open incident if >5% error rate for 30m. Need monitoring thresholds and exact alert text.

Dave (Eng): Monitoring thresholds proposal: error rate >2% over 10m = warn (no page); >5% over 5m = page. KV cache hitrate drop >10% = warn. Adding circuit-breaker metrics for fallback count.

ana (PM): Owners & immediate actions:
- SLA signoff: @ana (owner) — draft + legal/finance review by Thu EOD
- Monitoring thresholds & alerts: @dave (owner) — add to metrics + alert runbook by Wed
- Docs runbook + examples: @maria (owner) — first draft Thu
- Support playbook mapping & mapping table: @linda (owner) — publish internal doc Fri
- Pricing knobs & reserved numbers: @kevin-sales + @omar-finance — initial numbers Thu
Please paste PR links / docs as you update.

Dave (Eng): noted. I'll open PR: github.com/redwood/smartrouting/ops/heatmap-pr (includes load test artifacts).

maria (Docs): I'll create doc stub: /docs/ga/smartrouting-runbook.md and link PR when ready.

kevin-sales: If finance needs more time, can ops stub provisional pricing? We can publish with "introductory" label if necessary.

ana (PM): Provisional ok but label clearly: "Introductory pricing, subject to change". Legal language welcome.

tara-legal: Draft legal blurb: "Introductory pricing is provided for launch and may be updated with 30 days notice." Will put in PR.

omar-finance: I'll provide reserved capacity tiers + discount brackets by Thu noon.

linda (Support): Scheduling runbook review with oncall + CSMs Fri 10am — will share calendar invite.

ana (PM): Any unresolved blockers? If none, we'll take this to governance review next Tue. :thumbsup:

Dave (Eng): one open blocker — quantized model variant still shows +30% p95 in worst-case path. Working on fallback routing + kernel selection. Might need feature-flagged disable for GA.

maria (Docs): ack, will document the known QA delta and temporary flags in the runbook.

ana (PM): Thanks all. If you can't meet owner dates, ping me directly so we can re-scope.
